title: Product Specialist – Data Navigator
description:
FactSet creates flexible, open data and software solutions for over 200,000 investment professionals worldwide, providing instant access to financial data and analytics that investors use to make crucial decisions.

At FactSet, our values are the foundation of everything we do. They express how we act and operate , serve as a compass in our decision-making, and play a big role in how we treat each other, our clients, and our communities. We believe that the best ideas can come from anyone, anywhere, at any time, and that curiosity is the key to anticipating our clients’ needs and exceeding their expectations.

**Your Team's Impact:**

Data Solutions is a leading content delivery platform that provides clients with organized, connected, and easily accessible data through the Open: FactSet Marketplace. It supports multiple delivery technologies, databases, programming languages, and visualization tools to meet diverse client workflows. The SBU contributes over $173M in ASV, with double-digit year-over-year growth. Its portfolio includes Standard Data Feed, Data Exploration, OnDemand (API), Views, Cornerstone, Real-Time Products (Exchange Data Feed and Benchmark Feeds), Open: FactSet Marketplace, Quantopian Enterprise, and other non-workstation initiatives.

The Data Solutions team is seeking a Product Specialist to support product management, develop comprehensive knowledge of products and delivery technologies, expand product offerings, and enhance features focused on connectivity, scalability, and usability. The role involves close collaboration with global Content, Product, Strategy, Sales, Support, and Engineering teams..

**What You'll do:**

* Manage the group’s daily inflow of product requests and guide them to a meaningful and timely resolution.
* Communicate clear and detailed responses to requests while tying in references to supporting documentation.

**Contribution to Product Design and Maintenance**

* Assist product owners in spec’ing and designing products that capture market share in the financial data investments space.
* Contribute to departmental product development projects

**Critical Product Analysis**

* Identify recurring issues/requests and make recommendations for feature enhancements.
* Collection of metrics for product usage, issues reported time to first response, time to resolution, etc.
* Identify areas for improvement of Product Support

**Product Documentation and Education**

* Create and maintain support and troubleshooting documentation.
Regularly share Data Solutions product best practices with stakeholders  

**What We're Looking For:**

**Education:**

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems and/or Finance

  

* Experience: 2 - 6 Years of experience
* Led documentation strategy and execution for the Data Navigator product suite, aligning deliverables with product roadmaps and release schedules.
* Design and implement DITA-based structured authoring and information architecture frameworks to improve content reuse, consistency, and localization readiness.
* Author and maintain user guides, implementation guides, API documentation, developer guides, Python reference manuals, installation guides, and release notes.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and QA teams to ensure documentation accuracy through feature validation, GUI testing, and sprint participation.
* Manag documentation publishing workflows using Git, Perforce, and internal documentation portals.
* Establish documentation standards, templates, style guides, and review processes, improving content quality and reducing review cycle times.
* Mentor and coach junior technical writers, providing editorial guidance and fostering best practices in technical communication.
* Coordinate documentation delivery across multiple releases, ensuring timely publication of customer-facing and developer-focused content.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint reviews, and release readiness activities to maintain alignment with product development milestones.
* Log design and troubleshooting
* Experience working in Unix / Linux environments
* SQL and other RDBMS platforms
* Programmatic APIs
* Specification writing / technical documentation
* FQL, Kibana, Jenkins and GitHub
* Intermediate Python knowledge, R, Matlab
* Testing using Postman and CI/CD tools like Jenkins
* Able to understand a complicated technical product line, while being able to manage the complicated business rules surrounding these products.
* Functional understanding of Enterprise Data Delivery solutions
* Functional understanding of Software Development cycles
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word & PowerPoint)
* Strong organizational skills are needed to juggle multiple tasks.
* Attention to detail along with the ability to see the big picture.
* Ability to work on multiple projects with shifting priorities.
Self-disciplined and motivated work ethic.  

**Highly Desired Attributes:**

* Knowledge of financial databases used in financial markets.
* Knowledge of Product Development Life Cycle from Ideation to Go to Market
* Technical specification writing or maintenance experience of tools, enhancements, products.
* Ability to learn automation frameworks and conceptualization.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with team members in other offices.
* Knowledge or experience with analytical software from FactSet, CapIQ, Thomson Reuters or Bloomberg
Ability to learn to work with project management software and in Agile Environment  

**Company Overview:**

FactSet ( NYSE:FDS | NASDAQ:FDS ) helps the financial community to see more, think bigger, and work better. Our digital platform and enterprise solutions deliver financial data, analytics, and open technology to more than 8,200 global clients, including over 200,000 individual users. Clients across the buy-side and sell-side, as well as wealth managers, private equity firms, and corporations, achieve more every day with our comprehensive and connected content, flexible next-generation workflow solutions, and client-centric specialized support. As a member of the S&P 500, we are committed to sustainable growth and have been recognized among the Best Places to Work in 2023 by Glassdoor as a Glassdoor Employees’ Choice Award winner. Learn more at www.factset.com and follow us on X and LinkedIn .

At FactSet, we celebrate difference of thought, experience, and perspective. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to characteristics protected by law.

title: Events & Internal Communications Specialist
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

We are looking for a creative, organized, and execution-focused Events & Internal Communications Specialist to manage corporate events, employee engagement initiatives, and internal communications across Milestone’s global organization. The role will have dual ownership: planning and executing impactful corporate and employee events, while developing engaging internal communication programs that strengthen organizational culture, improve employee awareness, and reinforce leadership messaging.

The individual will work closely with global marketing, HR, leadership teams, regional business stakeholders, and external agencies to deliver consistent brand experiences and meaningful employee engagement. The ideal candidate should combine strong event management capabilities with excellent writing, storytelling, communication, and campaign execution skills.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Corporate Events & Experience Management**

* Plan, coordinate, and execute corporate events, customer engagements, employee celebrations, leadership meetings, town halls, and internal conferences.
* Manage end-to-end event execution, including concept development, planning, budgeting, vendor coordination, logistics, branding, production, and post-event reporting.
* Coordinate regional and global events, including customer conferences, partner events, industry forums, leadership offsites, and employee engagement programs.
* Develop event concepts, themes, creative directions, engagement activities, and event communication plans.
* Work with creative teams and agencies to develop event collateral, invitations, presentations, signage, stage branding, digital assets, and event experiences.
* Manage venue selection, travel coordination, accommodation, catering, technical requirements, and onsite event operations.
* Maintain an annual event calendar, event repository, vendor database, and budget tracker.

**Internal Communications Strategy & Execution**

* Execute internal communication plans aligned with company priorities, business updates, leadership messaging, and employee engagement objectives.
* Create and manage internal communication campaigns across email, intranet, collaboration platforms, and other employee communication channels.
* Translate business updates, organizational initiatives, milestones, and leadership messages into clear, engaging, and employee-friendly communication.
* Develop internal announcements, employee stories, leadership messages, campaign content, and organizational updates.
* Partner with PX and business leaders to communicate organizational initiatives, people programs, policy updates, and employee-related announcements.

**Leadership & Executive Communications**

* Develop and refine internal messages for the MD, CEO, and senior leadership.
* Support communication for town halls, quarterly business updates, leadership announcements, organizational milestones, and strategic initiatives.
* Translate leadership perspectives and business priorities into engaging and accessible communication.
* Develop scripts, speaking notes, presentation narratives, employee messages, and leadership video content.
* Maintain consistency in tone, messaging, and organizational positioning across leadership communications.

**Employee Engagement & Culture Campaigns**

* Conceptualize and execute employee engagement campaigns that strengthen belonging, collaboration, recognition, and organizational pride.
* Develop creative internal campaigns around company milestones, anniversaries, festivals, employee achievements, values, and organizational initiatives.
* Drive employee participation through interactive campaigns, contests, recognition programs, employee stories, and engagement activities.
* Support employer branding and employee advocacy initiatives in collaboration with PX and corporate marketing.
* Capture and amplify employee experiences, success stories, and workplace culture through internal channels.

**Content & Creative Coordination**

* Collaborate with Content writers to develop compelling communication content, including emails, newsletters, leadership messages, event invitations, etc.
* Collaborate with designers, video production teams, and agencies to develop creative assets and multimedia content.
* Ensure all communication and event assets adhere to corporate branding and editorial guidelines.
* Demonstrate strong storytelling skills and the ability to make corporate communication more human, engaging, and relatable.

**Measurement & Reporting**

* Track event performance, participation, employee engagement, feedback, and budget utilization.
* Measure internal communication effectiveness through readership, engagement, participation, and employee feedback.
* Develop post-event reports, campaign performance summaries, and recommendations for improvement.
* Maintain an organized repository of event photographs, videos, communication assets, and campaign outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to improve event experiences and internal communication effectiveness.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Mass Communication, Journalism, Public Relations, Event Management, or a related discipline.
* 5-8 years of experience in corporate event management, internal communications, employee engagement, or corporate marketing.
* Experience managing end-to-end corporate events and employee engagement programs.
* Strong writing, editing, storytelling, and communication skills.
* Experience developing leadership communication, internal newsletters, event scripts, and employee campaigns.
* Excellent project management, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, budgets, and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong creative thinking and attention to detail.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS):**

* Successful execution of corporate, customer, and employee events.
* Event delivery within approved budgets and timelines.
* Event feedback and satisfaction scores.
* Vendor performance and cost optimization.
* Quality and consistency of event branding and experience
* Timeliness and consistency of internal communications.
* Employee engagement with newsletters, announcements, and campaigns.
* Leadership communication effectiveness and content quality.
* Employee participation in internal campaigns and engagement initiatives.
* Effectiveness of communication across geographies and employee groups.

**Compensation**
----------------

Estimated Pay Range:  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**
-------------------------------------------

*At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.*  
  
*Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.*  
  
*We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.*

title: Lead Systems Operations Engineer(Technology Major Incident Management)
description:

title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Develop, review, and maintain production-quality SQL and database objects for PostgreSQL, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, DISTINCT ON patterns, conditional aggregation, and date-effective data selection.
* Tune queries used by Composite Services API workflows, including cash balance, assets under management (AUM), account indicators, holdings, maturities, group/party search, and transaction-related reads.
* Diagnose slow queries using EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) in approved non-production or controlled environments; interpret actual-versus-estimated rows, loops, buffer hits/reads, execution time, sort/hash behavior, and I/O waits.
* Identify and address performance issues caused by large intermediate result sets, repeated nested-loop lookups, inaccurate cardinality estimates, expensive aggregation, sort operations, and pagination applied after full aggregation.
* Design and validate indexes, including composite, partial, and expression indexes where appropriate; evaluate selectivity, column order, write overhead, and index maintenance costs before recommending changes.
* Improve pagination, filtering, ordering, and count-query patterns while maintaining correct totals, stable ordering, and API contract behavior. Assess keyset/cursor pagination where product behavior permits.
* Review data access patterns involving account, party, advisor, branch, balance, position, price, and FX relationships; validate join keys, effective-date rules, de-duplication, and missing-price or fallback logic.
* Analyze PostgreSQL runtime behavior including CPU versus I/O waits, temporary-file activity, sort/hash spills, locks, connection-pool pressure, statement timeouts, and read-replica lag.
* Collaborate with Java/Spring service engineers, DBAs, QA, and platform teams to trace API latency to SQL, reproduce issues with representative data volumes, and deliver measurable improvements.
* Create repeatable query-performance tests and document baseline plans, representative parameters, expected row counts, risks, and before/after results. Include performance checks in code review and release validation.
* Support production incidents through evidence-based diagnosis and follow established change, access-control, rollback, and data-protection procedures.
* Communicate findings clearly to technical and business stakeholders; explain trade-offs among latency, resource consumption, data freshness, and consistency.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Requirements / Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6–8 years of hands-on SQL development, with substantial experience building and tuning **PostgreSQL** workloads in a production environment.
* Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL query planning and execution, including EXPLAIN/EXPLAIN ANALYZE, buffers, join strategies, statistics, indexes, CTE behavior, aggregation, sorting, and parallel query considerations.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze high-row-count workloads and distinguish database execution time from connection acquisition, application processing, serialization, and network latency.
* Experience diagnosing major estimate-versus-actual row-count gaps and understanding how statistics and data distribution can influence plan selection.
* Practical experience tuning queries with joins and aggregation across large business datasets; ability to preserve correctness while reducing scanned rows, repeated lookups, and unnecessary intermediate results.
* Understanding of PostgreSQL transactions, isolation levels, read-only sessions, statement and lock timeouts, connection pooling, and safe cancellation behavior.
* Experience with Git-based source control, peer review, testing, and controlled release practices.
* Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills; able to take ownership of an issue from evidence gathering through validation.
* Strong analytical abilities and problem-solving skills; strong communication skills
* Experience using code management tools, for example GIT or BitBucket
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to show flexibility and reach compromise where appropriate
* Willingness to take ownership for assigned aspects of the project
* Ability to innovate and iterate, willingness to experiment quickly
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and an ability to work constructively in a shared team environment
* Good Communication skills.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL or PostgreSQL managed on AWS, including reader/writer endpoints, connection routing, replica lag, and failover considerations.
* Experience with performance observability tools such as pg\_stat\_statements, database load/wait dashboards, CloudWatch, or application tracing/APM.
* Experience with financial-services or wealth-management data, including accounts, parties, advisor/branch hierarchies, positions, balances, pricing, and FX conversion.
* Experience collaborating with Java/Spring services and understanding how datasource configuration, connection pools, request deadlines, and concurrent API traffic affect database load.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated SQL checks, and database change-management practices.

**Shift Timings:** UK Shift (1pm to 10pm)

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Must-Have Skills**
--------------------

* PostgreSQL
* Advanced SQL Development
* Query Performance Tuning
* EXPLAIN ANALYZE Execution Plan Analysis
* Indexing Strategies (Composite, Partial, Expression)
* Large Data Volume Optimization
* Production Support & Troubleshooting
* Git/BitBucket

**Nice-to-Have Skills**
-----------------------

* AWS Aurora PostgreSQL
* pg\_stat\_statements
* CloudWatch / APM Tools
* Java/Spring Ecosystem Knowledge
* CI/CD Pipelines
* Wealth Management / Financial Services Domain

**Must Have Skill**
-------------------

PostgreSQL,SQL Proficiency

**Good to Have Skill**
----------------------

title: Senior Medical Editor (QC and Regulatory Editing)
description:
Senior Medical Editor (QC and Regulatory Editing)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.
  
  
Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.
  
  
Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.
  
  
Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities:**

* Represents the editorial group in medical writing, on study teams, and in cross-departmental project teams as needed.

* Monitors timelines and budgets for assigned projects and updates the lead medical writer, project manager, and/or direct supervisor (as appropriate) if deliverables are at risk.

* Provides technical support and expertise as appropriate. Conducts training of medical editing staff and functions as a mentor. title: Senior Content Writer
description:
### **Role Overview**

SIONIQ is seeking a creative, detail-oriented and SEO-driven Content Writer to produce engaging, accurate and high-quality content across digital platforms. The role combines brand storytelling, campaign copywriting and product communication with keyword research, search-focused writing and ongoing content optimization to strengthen brand awareness, organic visibility, and business growth.

### **Content Writing & Copywriting**

* Research, write, edit and proofread original website copy, blogs, articles, landing pages, product descriptions and marketing collateral.
* Develop compelling headlines, taglines, campaign messages and calls to action for diverse business audiences.
* Simplify technical and product information into clear, accessible, benefit-led communication.
* Maintain consistent brand voice, accuracy, readability and originality across channels.
* Write white papers, public relations (PR) content, press releases, media announcements, and corporate communications that strengthen brand credibility.

### **SEO Content Writing & Optimization**

* Conduct keyword research, assess search intent, and identify relevant content opportunities.
* Create search-optimized blogs, articles, website pages and landing pages aligned with business goals.
* Apply on-page SEO practices including metadata, headings, internal links, descriptive URLs and image alt text.
* Develop pillar pages, topic clusters and supporting content to build topical relevance.
* Audit and refresh existing content; analyze competitor content and keyword gaps.
* Develop SEO-optimized product use cases and customer case studies, including search-intent-led structure, relevant keywords, metadata and internal links.
* Stay informed about search algorithm changes and emerging search experiences.

### **Social Media & Creative Content**

* Write platform-appropriate captions, carousel copy and promotional content for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube.
* Develop concepts and scripts for reels, promotional videos and brand campaigns.
* Repurpose long-form material into engaging short-form social and email content.
* Collaborate with designers and marketers on creative execution.

### **Product & Brand Communication**

* Create product-focused content, brochures, case studies, customer stories and presentations.
* Explain customer challenges, product use cases and business benefits through compelling storytelling.
* Research B2B technology trends, audience needs and competitor positioning.
* Coordinate with product and sales teams to verify technical and business claims.

### **Marketing Campaign Content**

* Write persuasive copy for Google Ads, Meta Ads, email marketing and lead-generation campaigns.
* Create newsletters, promotional messages and conversion-focused landing page content.
* Support product launches and brand-awareness initiatives with audience-specific messaging.

### **Content Planning & Performance**

* Contribute to content calendars and deliver assignments to agreed deadlines.
* Monitor clicks, organic traffic, keyword rankings and engagement; recommend improvements.

### **Required Candidate Profile**

* 5–6 years of professional content writing experience, including SEO-focused writing.
* Excellent written English, grammar, research, editing and storytelling skills.
* Experience producing blogs, articles, website copy, social media content and marketing materials.
* Practical understanding of keyword research, search intent, on-page SEO and content optimisation.
* Familiarity with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs or similar tools.
* Ability to simplify complex technical information and adapt tone to the audience and platform.
* Strong attention to detail, time management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Portfolio of published writing and SEO content samples required.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Experience with B2B, SaaS, ERP, IT or technology brands.
* WordPress or other content management systems; video scriptwriting and product storytelling.
* Basic technical and off-page SEO knowledge; familiarity with AI-assisted research and editing tools.
* Understanding of content funnels and conversion-focused copywriting.

### **Education**

Bachelor’s degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Communications, Marketing or a related discipline.

### **Key Skills**

Content Writing | SEO Content Writing | Copywriting | Blog Writing | Website Content | Keyword Research | On-Page SEO | Social Media Content | Brand Storytelling | Product Writing | Script Writing | Proofreading | Editing | B2B Content Marketing | White Paper Writing | Public Relations (PR) | Press Releases | Use Cases | Case Studies

description:

title: Controls Projects - Process Development & Documentation Engineer
description:
Want to be part of Energy Transformation, have a meaningful career, work on complex solutions like carbon capture, decarbonization, fast power and grid reconstruction & stabilization that will change the way power is delivered to the world? Come join one of the most formidable design teams in the Power Industry, GEV’s Gas Power Controls team. At GEV Gas Power Controls, we design and implement control solutions that have meaningful impact on people’s lives and enable the transformation of the energy sector. You will be empowered, work in a Scaled Agile Framework environment (SAFe) driving meaningful changes and continuous improvement using Lean principles. You will have a complete life cycle experience from initial concept development through detailed design, implementation, and upgrades, working with over five hundred global engineers with a single purpose; deliver the cleanest, most efficient power to our customers with the Operability needed in today’s dynamic power grid.
  
The Controls Projects - Process Development & Documentation Engineer is responsible for capturing, formalizing, and continuously improving the engineering execution processes used by the HDNU Controls Projects teams. The successful candidate will partner closely with HDNU ITR Solutioning leader, Controls Projects Leaders, Alliance team members, Architects and the Controlled Title Holder (CTH) to document current-state processes, apply Lean methodologies to identify and eliminate waste, and publish standardized, repeatable job aids, checklists, and process guides that drive first-pass yield (FPY), reduce cycle time, and build a culture of execution excellence.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

  
  

* Partner with HDNU ITR Solutioning leader, Controls Projects Leaders, Alliance team members, architects, Controlled Title Holders (CTH), and Controls leadership to validate process documentation for accuracy and applicability.
* Coordinate with CLM administrators and Confluence page owners to maintain platform governance and documentation integrity.
* Present process improvement plans, documentation status, and Lean workout outcomes to team and business leaders.
* Support onboarding of new engineers by ensuring documented job aids and checklists serve as effective training tools, eliminating reliance on informally held process knowledge.
* Drives PI planning & Retrospective for sprint (agile execution methodologies) with Controls Project leaders & RTE on Project execution’s health as part of daily management.
  

  

**Process Documentation & Standardization**

  
  

* Capture and formalize current-state execution processes across all projects and applicable milestones from Project Release through COD, including: CKOM, Hardware & Software design, and delivery.
* Author, publish, and maintain Job Aids, Checklists, and Process Guides for all Project milestones.
* Establish and maintain proper linkage between Confluence and CLM milestone descriptions.
* Reorganize Confluence pages under New Units (Plant Fulfillment) to create a using ISO 9001-2025 standards, logical, navigable, and consistently maintained documentation architecture.
* Update Projects Milestone Checklists and Job Aids and support their pilot use on projects to validate accuracy and usability.
  

  

**Lean Process Improvement**

* Apply Lean tools and methodologies — including Problem Solving Reports (PSR), Gemba Walks, Kaizen Events, 3x5 Why (Root Cause Analysis), Value Stream Mapping (VSM), and daily management practices identifying waste, reducing cycle time, and improving execution quality across HDNU extended scope milestone processes.
* Lead or support VSM Current State and Future State exercises for Project milestone execution, building on the VSM review conducted during the Lean Workout.
  

  
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, or related discipline) from an accredited college or university.
* Minimum 6 to 10 years of experience in controls engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical execution role within the power generation industry.
* Strong technical writing skills with demonstrated ability to make the author clear, structured process documentation, job aids, checklists, and work instructions.
  

  

**Desired Characteristics**

  
  

* Demonstrated experience with Gas Turbine, Steam Turbine or DCS Controls environments, including familiarity with milestone-based software execution processes (Alpha, Integration, Comm SW, Charlie, First Fire).
* Demonstrated experience applying Lean methodologies in an engineering or manufacturing environment, including VSM, PSR, Gemba, Kaizen, and root cause analysis tools such as 3x5 Why.
* Familiarity with Confluence (or equivalent engineering knowledge management platforms) and CLM (or equivalent test management/checklist platforms).
* Experience with GE Vernova tools and platforms, including ControlST, AVEVA (IO tools), ACME, Mark Vie, PLM and CLM.
* Experience working in a globally matrixed environment with strong collaboration and cross-functional influence skills.
* Knowledge of agile execution methodologies and experience structuring engineering work as user stories or checklist-based tasks.
* Lean certification (Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher, or equivalent GE Vernova Lean training) is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to independently drive projects to completion with minimal oversight, with a bias for action and continuous improvement.  

* Note:
    
  **To comply with US immigration and other legal requirements, it is necessary to specify the minimum number of years' experience required for any role based within the USA.** **For roles outside of the USA, to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, the JDs should focus on the substantive level of experience required for the role and a minimum number of years should NOT be used.**

==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Supervisor, Technical Writer
description:
**Description**

**Who is USP?**

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

**Brief Job Overview**

The Supervisor, Technical Writer supports USP’s global Advanced Manufacturing Technologies (AMT) and Resiliency Center work by developing clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate materials for external use. This role translates scientific, technical, and operational information for external audiences and supports alignment between content development and community engagement activities. The Supervisor, Technical Writer collaborates with technical experts, project leads, and communications stakeholders across regions and supervises the Community Engagement Specialist.

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Supervisor, Technical Writer has the following responsibilities:

* Develop written content such as articles, briefs, reports, blogs, presentations, case studies, and other communication materials supporting AMT and Supply Chain Solutions initiatives.
* Translate complex scientific, technical, manufacturing, and supply chain information — including technical outlines, interview notes, research findings, meeting summaries, and subject matter expert input — into clear, accurate, and accessible written materials for external audiences.
* Collaborate with subject matter experts and project teams to gather information, validate technical accuracy, and incorporate feedback throughout the content development process.
* Support market-facing, educational, conference, and sales enablement materials that communicate USP's global AMT and Resiliency Center expertise, programs, services, and public health mission.
* Edit and refine draft materials to improve clarity, consistency, readability, and audience relevance.
* Apply USP brand standards, messaging priorities, and scientific quality expectations to written materials.
* Supervise the Community Engagement Specialist and support alignment between technical content and community engagement activities.
* Other duties as assigned

**Strategic Value**

* Supports USP's global AMT and Resiliency Center visibility in international and commercial markets by turning internal technical expertise into clear, practical materials for external audiences.
* Strengthens credibility and supports inbound interest by helping USP communicate AMT and Resiliency Center work in a consistent, audience-appropriate way.

**Who is USP Looking For?**

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:

* The successful candidate will demonstrate strong writing and communication skills, along with the ability to work effectively with technical subject matter experts and diverse stakeholders.
* Minimum qualifications include a bachelor's degree in a relevant field and at least four years of related experience in technical writing, scientific communications, content development, or a similar role supporting technical or scientific audiences.
* Experience developing written content such as articles, briefs, white papers, reports, presentations, or similar materials.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical or scientific concepts into content that is clear, accurate, and accessible to broader audiences.
* Experience supporting content development that involves input from multiple subject matter experts and stakeholders, including synthesizing technical feedback and incorporating it into clear, accurate written materials.
